reviews.text: I signed up for this app and then it was giving me the wrong information on the plants I have. I signed up to remind me before the trial period was going to end. I was never notified. So then they charged me for the next month. I went into my account immediately and cancelled my subscription. My account at the top of the page asked restore purchase? I went into my account and sent them a message requesting my refund before it cleared my bank. So in plenty of time! No one returned my message and I wasn’t refunded my money!! I am still waiting. Be very wary of this app!!!!! They scam you out of your money!!! I am pretty sure I will be fighting this for awhile!!!😡😡😡

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
This app is a scam!! When I click delete account it will NOT delete it constantly says it’s loading and nothing happens! When I go to manage subscription it all of a sudden asks me to sign in? But I don’t know what I’m
Supposed to sign into I never had to sign into an extra account when i first subscribed but when I want to cancel or “manage” subscription it wants me to sign in to something? So I try sign in, doesn’t work, I click forgot password they say they sent me a email to reset password but NO EMAIL ever received!!! Then I email them and complain and tell them to delete subscription and account and they won’t do it, and now sure enough they had the cheek to take 9.99 out of my account even tho I been trying to cancel!! Apple I want to report this as a scam pls and anyone reading this stay far away!!!!

reviews.title: Absolutely awful
reviews.text: There is no customer service number, when you try to reset your password, you NEVER get the email with the rest link. On top of that, even emailing the company, you don’t get a response about cancellation or a refund AFTER having tried all of those methods. Don’t do it. It’s not worth it.

reviews.title: Scam - stay away!!!
reviews.text: This app is scam. When I try to cancel my subscription it tells me my password is wrong, I generate password reminder emails but the link is always invalid. When I try to delete my account it either doesn’t load or it says the app is under maintenance. I have emailed the app support repeatedly and I always receive an automated answer that is not at all helpful, and no further emails. There is no other way to contact them. This app is a scam - stay away!!!!

reviews.title: Over charging!
reviews.text: Be careful with this app. Even canceling within the free trial period, they have continued to charge me for the last four months. Customer service does not return email messages and has provided no response to how to fix the issue. They will also not allow your credit card to cancel the charges!
